  - The tasklist says all three tasks are done; I could confirm two of them, so `tasklist_completion_pct` is 0.67.

The dropped claim was "the empty-input test is enough for R-003", which was inference presented as fact. The Tier-1 card's false "artifacts/artifacts path" recommendation was also removed: the calibrator showed the path was correct.
